mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.provider_tick_sequences (game_id, provider_id, sequence_id, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{providerId}, #{sequenceId}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, provider_id, sequence_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", provider_id AS "providerId", sequence_id AS "sequenceId", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.provider_tick_sequences WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, provider_id, sequence_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.provider_tick_sequences_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, provider_id, sequence_id ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, provider_id, sequence_id FROM public.provider_tick_sequences WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, provider_id, sequence_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision
